name: Firbolg
summary: Gentle giant-kin who guard the deep forests. Firbolgs prefer to stay unseen, speak with animals and plants, and use quiet magic to protect their homes.

age.summary: Firbolgs come of age around 30 and can live up to 500 years.

size.description: Firbolgs are 7 to 8 feet tall and weigh 240 to 300 pounds.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common, Elvish, Giant.

features.name: Firbolg Magic
features.summary: You can cast detect magic and disguise self once each per short or long rest. Disguise self can make you look up to 3 feet shorter. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Hidden Step
features.summary: As a bonus action, you turn invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage or force a save. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Powerful Build
features.summary: You count as one size larger when working out your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag or lift.

features.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
features.summary: Beasts and plants understand the meaning of your words, and you have advantage on Charisma checks to influence them.
